== Printing-specific Revised face ==
Correction to the earlier printing-source note: the archived Decipher white-border GIF is a digital rendition with a 1997 legal line. The newly checked physical white card has a 1999 legal line. Both faces print "Use your Force one by one"; the article and checklist had omitted "your". The new photograph documents the physical Revised face. The old publisher GIF, its File history and checked archive-byte evidence remain valid for the digital rendition.
